Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Plumbers annual median?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters ($103,380). Among metros with a published median: Chicago $103,380, Seattle $95,230, Austin $62,810. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Plumbers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters (12,750 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 12,750, Seattle 6,350, Austin 5,260. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Plumbers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (1.36). Published LQs: Austin 1.36, Seattle 1.02, Chicago 0.94.

What is the hourly median for Plumbers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $30.20; Chicago $49.70; Seattle $45.78. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
